description_for_human: AI-powered care compliance: EMAR audits, care plans, risk assessments, visit audits, drug interaction checks, email rewriting, and platform data access.

functions.name: getAIStatus
functions.description: Check if AI features are enabled and available on the CareAssurance platform.

functions.name: getDashboard
functions.description: Get platform dashboard statistics including counts of service users, care workers, audits, and discrepancies.

functions.name: getCareWorkers
functions.description: Get the list of care workers with their names, roles, and status.

functions.name: getAudits
functions.description: Get recent EMAR audit history with audit details, discrepancy counts, and status.

functions.name: getDiscrepancies
functions.description: Get all recorded compliance discrepancies with types, severity, status, and care worker details.

functions.name: rewriteEmail
functions.description: Rewrite or polish an email with a specified tone (professional, direct, empathetic, formal, or urgent). Optionally generates a subject line.

functions.name: generatePRNProtocol
functions.description: Generate a clinically accurate UK PRN (as-needed) medication protocol including dose, route, frequency, max 24hr dose, side effects, and monitoring requirements.

functions.name: analyzeVisitLogs
functions.description: Audit visit logs using triple-check validation: location verification (200m), duration compliance (>=70%), note quality assessment, and concern detection.

functions.name: analyzeRisks
functions.description: Scan uploaded documents to identify risk areas, recommend assessment categories from 20+ options, and provide evidence summaries.

functions.name: generateRiskAssessment
functions.description: Create a complete risk assessment for a specific category with hazard identification, risk ratings, control measures, and action plans following NHS 12 Principles.

functions.name: generateCarePlan
functions.description: Generate a full 12-section CQC 2024-compliant care plan. Supports call types: morning, lunch, tea, bed, domestic, general.

functions.name: enhanceCarePlan
functions.description: Improve and enhance an existing care plan by merging it with new supporting documents (M&H assessments, GP letters, medical records).

functions.name: checkDrugInteractions
functions.description: Check drug-drug interactions for a list of medications. Returns severity levels (mild, moderate, severe, critical) and clinical guidance.

functions.name: chatWithCompliee
functions.description: Ask the Compli-ee assistant a general question about CareAssurance platform features, workflows, or care compliance guidance.
